description.value:
A heavy grimoire bound in grey hide, its pages crowded with Foras's cramped hand and diagrams of spheres that hurt to follow. The notes describe a door half-finished for Yog-Sothoth.

The Codex holds five rare spells: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.FEsuyf203wTNE2et]{Wails of the Damned}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.m3lcOFm400lQCUps]{Power Word Kill} and @UUID[Compendium.kingmaker-cyclops-thresholders.items.Item.3XBb9RtCq9Wihewn]{The Hours Unbound} (9th rank), and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1dsahW4g1ggXtypx]{Freeze Time} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.U13bC0tNgrlHoeTK]{Gate} (10th rank).

Learning a spell from the Codex uses @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Q5iIYCFdqJFM31GW]{Learn a Spell} at DC 42 for a 9th-rank spell and DC 47 for a 10th-rank spell.
description.gm:
Regard. Each reading draws the regard of something beyond the spheres. The party shares one Regard track from 0 to 20; keep the number hidden and show the omens.

Learn a Spell result9th rank10th rank
Critical success (learned)+0+1
Success (learned)+1+2
Failure+2+2
Critical failure+3 and a Glimpse+3 and a Glimpse

Stare Longer. After a failure, the reader may retry at once for +2 more Regard.

Echoes. The first time each week a character casts a spell learned from the Codex, add 1 Regard (Gate adds 2). The Hours Unbound adds 1 on every cast.

Mitigation. Warded study: Weight −1 (minimum 0). Second mind: another character reads the marginalia aloud, Occultism DC 38; success reduces the result cost by 1, critical failure raises it by 1. Blot the pages: burn a learned spell's pages to remove 1 Regard; nobody else can learn it from the book. Rite of Effacement: a week of downtime and a Religion check against DC 40; critical success −4, success −2, failure 0, critical failure +1. Once per week of downtime, never below the last omen threshold reached.

Omens. 5 The Glance (clocks run wrong, dreams of spheres) · 10 The Heralds (one encounter with creatures of about 16th level) · 15 The Thinning (teleportation within 1 mile of a reader needs a DC 11 flat check; the GM sets the arrival within 1d4 weeks) · 20 The Arrival (the Iridescent Herald manifests).

Glimpse (1d6). 1 the reader ages 1d10 years · 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} until the next daily preparation · 3 the reader's shadow points towards the Codex · 4 one random prepared spell vanishes for the day · 5 the reader speaks a stranger's name; later a herald answers to it · 6 +2 further Regard.
